title: Dealer Warranty Claims Settlement
summary: Check warranty claims from dealers and service centres against warranty terms, serial numbers, sale dates, returned parts and labour rates before finance reimburses them.

seo.title: Warranty Claims Verification for Dealers | VipraTech
seo.description: Verify dealer and service-centre warranty claims against warranty terms, serial numbers, sale dates, returned parts and labour rates before reimbursement.

problem.intro: Brands of durables, electronics, batteries, tyres and auto components reimburse dealers and service centres for repairs and replacements under warranty. Each claim carries a serial number, sale date, fault, parts and labour. Without checking those against sales records and warranty terms, claims for out-of-warranty products, repeated repairs and parts never returned get paid.

pain_points.title: Products outside warranty
pain_points.detail: Serial numbers sold long ago, sold in another region or never sold at all are claimed as in warranty.

pain_points.title: Repeat and duplicate claims
pain_points.detail: The same serial number or job is claimed more than once, by one or several service centres.

pain_points.title: Parts not returned
pain_points.detail: Replaced parts that should come back for inspection never do.

pain_points.title: Labour and parts above rates
pain_points.detail: Labour hours and part prices exceed the agreed rate card.

solution.overview: VipraTech reads warranty claims with their job cards, invoices and photos, and checks each one against the serial number's sale record and the warranty terms for that product. It flags serial numbers out of warranty or with earlier claims, parts not received back, and labour or parts above the rate card. Claims that pass go to the reimbursement sheet, and the rest go to the service team with the reason.
capabilities: Checks serial numbers against sale records and warranty terms
Finds repeat and duplicate claims across service centres
Tracks parts that should be returned
Recalculates labour and parts from the rate card
Fault and claim trends by product, region and service centre

workflow.title: Receive claims
workflow.detail: Dealers and service centres submit claims with job cards, invoices and photos.

workflow.title: Check the product
workflow.detail: Each serial number is checked against its sale record and warranty terms.

workflow.title: Check history
workflow.detail: Earlier claims on the same serial number are found across service centres.

workflow.title: Check amounts
workflow.detail: Labour and parts are recalculated from the rate card, and returned parts are confirmed.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: The service team reviews flagged claims with the reason.

inputs: Warranty claims with job cards and invoices
Serial number sale and dispatch records
outputs: Claims checked for warranty, history and rates
Repeat, out-of-warranty and overcharged claims flagged
Claim trends by product, region and service centre
human_in_the_loop: The service team decides on flagged claims, especially technical judgements about the fault. Finance approves every reimbursement.
integrations: Service or CRM system for job cards
ERP for sales, serial numbers and payouts
guardrails: No reimbursement without a valid serial and sale record
Rates taken from the version valid on the repair date
Technical decisions left to the service team

pilot.scope: One product line, with three months of settled warranty claims as the benchmark.
deliverables: Warranty terms and rate card as rules

what_we_measure.how: Out-of-warranty, repeat or overcharged claims confirmed by the service team.
Claims where parts were due back but not received.
Time to process a month of claims, compared with today.

faqs.q: Can it judge whether the fault is genuine?
faqs.a: No. Technical judgement stays with your service team. The system checks eligibility, history, rates and evidence, and shows trends that point to where to look.

faqs.q: Our serial numbers are not always recorded at sale. Does that matter?
faqs.a: Where sale records are missing, dispatch dates and invoice copies can be used instead, and those claims are marked as having weaker evidence.

faqs.q: Can it handle replacement claims for batteries or tyres?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro-rata and free-replacement terms are configured as rules for each product.
Distributor claims settlement is live today. Warranty claims settlement is in early access: we are building it with a small number of brands as design partners.
